تحتقبون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَقِبُونَ (taḥtaqibūna) /taħ.ta.qi.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# تُحْتَقَبُونَ (tuḥtaqabūna) /tuħ.ta.qa.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
